explanation: The statement is phrased entirely in the library's own vocabulary: `AlgebraicCurve.Pic0`, `Pic0.mk`, `Divisor.degZero`, `AlgebraicCurve.CurveModel`, `Mdl.pointEquivPlace`, `ModularCurve.igusaFunctionFieldX1C`, `ModularCurve.TwoChart.modelTo`, `ModularCurve.TwoChart.ιFin`, `SchemeHomOver`, `Pic0.mem_closure_mk_single_sub_single_of_notMem`, etc. Searching Mathlib (and Batteries/Lean core) for `Pic0`, `CurveModel`, `igusaFunctionField`, `TwoChart`, `pointEquivPlace` and `mem_closure_mk_single` yields no matches at all, so none of the concepts involved (divisor class group Pic0 of a curve over a field, curve models, Igusa function fields, modular curves place maps) exist in Mathlib. The proof relies on library-local lemmas (`AlgebraicCurve.Pic0.mem_closure_mk_single_sub_single_of_notMem`, `GenChartTools.good_point`, `Mdl.infinite_place`), none of which has a Mathlib counterpart, and the statement has no Mathlib analogue.
